Preface - About The Programmer's Kit

For users who wish to access network information, Cyberdog is a set of tools with which to search and browse the Internet, access Internet mail and newsgroups, and access content located on the Internet.

For developers who wish to provide such tools, Cyberdog is a collection of OpenDoc classes and extensions for creating OpenDoc parts that access and display remotely located content. This book and its accompanying CD-ROM disk make up the Cyberdog Programmer's Kit. It provides the tools you need and shows you how to develop Cyberdog components.
